programmes.d: When a Florida couple gives up their huge condo so they can hit the road, John and Zack attempt to build a tiny house where the nocturnal nurse and his sun-loving bride can coexist.

Kyle and Jennifer ask John and Zack to build them a completely modern tiny house tricked out with smart gadgets.
